menu_import.title: Import a menu
menu_import.intro: Turn a menu photo or PDF into an editable draft for your restaurant.
menu_import.no_structure: Choose a restaurant from your dashboard first.
menu_import.demo_notice: You can upload and save menus in this shared demo. Everyone shares its import quota, and demo menus are restored on scheduled resets. Use your own account to keep your menus.
menu_import.limits: One PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP. Up to 8 MB, 5 PDF pages and 150 dishes. Use a clear, well-lit photo.
menu_import.consent: I have permission to send this menu to Google Gemini for processing.
menu_import.privacy: FoodBoard does not store the original file. Google processes it under your project’s Gemini API terms. Avoid uploading private or personal information.
menu_import.wait: This can take up to 90 seconds. Keep this page open.
menu_import.sample_source: Sample: Garden pasta 12.50; Grilled vegetables, Small 9.00 / Large 14.00. Pasta explicitly contains gluten.
menu_import.review_help: Compare every dish and price with the original. Review allergens with the restaurant; AI can miss details.
menu_import.restaurant_currency: Your restaurant uses {currency}. Importing does not change that setting or convert prices.
menu_import.currency_mismatch: The currencies do not match. Check the restaurant’s currency setting and the source prices before saving. No currency conversion is performed.
menu_import.currency_unknown: No currency was detected. Confirm that these prices use your restaurant’s currency.
menu_import.empty: Keep at least one dish to save this menu.
menu_import.confirm_review: I checked the dish names, prices and currency against the original.
menu_import.unpublished: The menu will be saved as unpublished. You can edit it further and publish it from your dashboard.
menu_import.discard: Leave this import? Unsaved edits will be lost. If a save is still pending, check your dashboard before importing again.
menu_import.save_pending: The previous save could not be confirmed. Editing is paused; retry to confirm the same save without creating a duplicate.

errors.connection_error: Could not connect. Check your connection and try again.
errors.import_disabled: Menu import is not enabled yet. Follow the project setup guide.
errors.import_not_configured: The Gemini API key or model is not configured on the backend.
errors.origin_not_allowed: This website is not in the backend’s allowed origins.
errors.not_authenticated: Sign in with your confirmed account, then try again.
errors.not_owner: You can only import into your own restaurant.
errors.demo_import_disabled: Use your own account to import; the shared demo cannot call Gemini.
errors.invalid_request: This import request is invalid. Choose the file again.
errors.unsupported_file: Choose a PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP file.
errors.file_too_large: The file is too large. Maximum size is 8 MB.
errors.invalid_pdf: This PDF is damaged or password protected. Export an unlocked PDF and try again.
errors.too_many_pages: Use a PDF with no more than five pages.
errors.import_limit_reached: Import limit reached. Wait a minute and retry. Limits: 3 attempts per account and 20 across FoodBoard per UTC day; concurrent requests may also need a short wait.
errors.provider_limit_reached: Google’s API quota is temporarily exhausted. Try again later.
errors.provider_unavailable: Gemini could not finish this request. Try a clearer or smaller menu; an attempted request may count toward your quota.
errors.extraction_incomplete: Gemini returned an incomplete result. Try a shorter menu.
errors.invalid_extraction: No usable menu was found. Try a clearer menu photo or PDF.
errors.invalid_draft: Check that all names and categories are filled in and the menu is within the limits.
errors.invalid_prices: Enter every price as a number with a decimal point, such as 12.50. Remove unwanted price variants.
errors.empty_category: Remove categories that have no dishes.
errors.too_many_items: A menu can contain up to 150 imported dishes.
errors.import_conflict: This import was already saved with different content. Check your dashboard before importing again.
errors.save_unavailable: The save could not be confirmed. Retry the same draft to avoid duplicates.
errors.currency_mismatch: The currencies do not match. Check the restaurant’s currency setting and the source prices before saving. No currency conversion is performed.
errors.not_a_menu: No dishes were found. Make sure the file is a menu, or try a sharper photo.

menu_import.allergen_step_help: Compare each dish with the allergen declarations on the original menu. AI can misread a legend, and an unticked box does not mean a dish is allergen-free.
menu_import.confirm_allergens: I checked the allergens of every dish against the original menu.
menu_import.restored_source: Draft restored from your last visit. The original file is not kept, so open it separately to compare.

delete_restaurant_help: Delete this restaurant and all its menus, categories and dishes. Its public menu link will stop working. This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_menu: Delete menu “{name}” and all its categories and dishes? This cannot be undone.
confirm_delete_restaurant: Delete restaurant “{name}” and all its menus, categories and dishes? Its public link will stop working. This cannot be undone.
delete_failed: Deletion failed. Your data may still be present; refresh and try again.
delete_protected: The shared demo restaurant and its menus can't be deleted. Sign up for your own workspace to try deletion.
